title: Cows in the Vortex
description: Two cows, one white and one brown, stand in the foreground with mouths open as if bellowing. Above them, wooden farm gates and fences are violently swirling and breaking apart within a dark, turbulent vortex under a stormy purple and blue sky.
prompt: Surreal dark painting of two realistic cows standing in the foreground, one white one brown, both with mouths open. Above them a massive swirling vortex of dark blue and purple pulls broken wooden farm gates, fences and debris into a chaotic spiral. Dramatic swirling brushstrokes, turbulent stormy sky, intense motion, moody and apocalyptic atmosphere, painted in rich dark tones.
